steps.command:
cat /etc/os-release | head -5
which nginx || echo "nginx not installed"
ls /etc/nginx/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no /etc/nginx"
ls /etc/nginx/conf.d/ 2>/dev/null
ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ 2>/dev/null
ls -la /var/www/html 2>/dev/null || echo "no docroot"
id

ls -la /var/lib/ | head -30
echo "--- dpkg ---"; ls -la /var/lib/dpkg 2>&1 | head
echo "--- apt ---"; ls -la /var/lib/apt 2>&1 | head
echo "--- which apt ---"; which apt-get dpkg
echo "--- mount ---"; mount | head -20
echo "--- disk ---"; df -h /
cat /etc/apt/sources.list 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ 2>/dev/null

echo "--- nginx-related binaries/libs present? ---"
ls /usr/sbin/nginx /usr/bin/nginx 2>&1
find /usr/lib /lib -maxdepth 3 \( -name 'libpcre*' -o -name 'libssl*' -o -name 'libz.so*' -o -name 'libcrypto*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "--- compilers/tools ---"
which gcc make curl wget tar dpkg-deb apt-get python3 busybox 2>&1
echo "--- /var contents ---"; find /var -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "--- /tmp ---"; ls -la /tmp
echo "--- env proxy ---"; env | grep -i proxy
sbx --help 2>&1 | head -50; echo "---"; sbx run --help 2>&1 | head -50

echo "persist-test-123" > /var/persist-test.txt
echo "tmp-test-123" > /tmp/persist-test.txt
mkdir -p /workspace/.persist-check && echo "ws-test-123" > /workspace/.persist-check/test.txt
ls -l /var/persist-test.txt /tmp/persist-test.txt /workspace/.persist-check/test.txt
# overlay test
mkdir -p /var/ovl-upper /var/ovl-work /var/ovl-merged
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/etc,upperdir=/var/ovl-upper,workdir=/var/ovl-work /var/ovl-merged && echo "OVERLAY OK" || echo "OVERLAY FAILED"
touch /var/ovl-merged/test-write && echo "overlay writable" || echo "overlay not writable"
mount | grep -E 'overlay| /etc | /usr ' | head

for f in /var/persist-test.txt /tmp/persist-test.txt /workspace/.persist-check/test.txt; do
  if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "PERSIST: $f ($(cat $f))"; else echo "GONE: $f"; fi
done

echo "--- /opt ---"; find /opt -maxdepth 3 2>/dev/null | head -40
echo "--- /usr/local ---"; find /usr/local -maxdepth 2 2>/dev/null | head -40
echo "--- boot hooks ---"; ls -la /etc/rc.local /etc/init.d/ 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "--- profile.d ---"; ls /etc/profile.d/ 2>/dev/null
echo "--- cron ---"; ls -la /etc/cron* 2>/dev/null | head
echo "--- processes ---"; ps aux 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- guest agent ---"; find /tmp/guest-agent -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- cmdline ---"; cat /proc/cmdline
echo "--- fstab ---"; cat /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null
echo "--- workspace contents ---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 | head -40

find /opt/testbed-src -maxdepth 4 -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -100
echo "--- grep nginx ---"
grep -ril nginx /opt/testbed-src 2>/dev/null | head -30

echo "HOME=$HOME"; echo "PATH=$PATH"; echo "SHELL=$SHELL"; echo "PWD=$PWD"; env | sort | head -40
echo "--- /etc/passwd root ---"; grep '^root:' /etc/passwd
echo "--- shell invocation ---"; ls -l /bin/sh; head -c 200 /tmp/guest-agent/ga-cmd-5 2>/dev/null; echo

set -x
mkdir -p /var/base
mount -o ro /dev/vda /var/base || exit 1
ls -la /var/base/var/lib/dpkg 2>&1 | head
ls -la /var/base/var/lib/dpkg/status 2>&1
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt
cp -a /var/base/var/lib/dpkg /var/lib/ 2>&1
mkdir -p /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/parts
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
echo "UPDATE EXIT=$?"
apt-cache policy nginx nginx-common nginx-core nginx-full 2>&1 | head -40

set -e
mkdir -p /var/base && mount -o ro /dev/vda /var/base
mkdir -p /var/overlay/usr/upper /var/overlay/usr/work /var/overlay/etc/upper /var/overlay/etc/work
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/usr,upperdir=/var/overlay/usr/upper,workdir=/var/overlay/usr/work /usr
mount -t overlay overlay -o lowerdir=/etc,upperdir=/var/overlay/etc/upper,workdir=/var/overlay/etc/work /etc
mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /run
mkdir -p /run/lock
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' > /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
chmod +x /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt
cp -a /var/base/var/lib/dpkg /var/lib/
mkdir -p /var/lib/dpkg/updates /var/lib/dpkg/parts
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-cache show nginx 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(Package|Depends|Recommends):' | head
echo "=== INSTALL ==="
apt-get install -y -qq nginx
echo "INSTALL EXIT=$?"
which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1
ls -l /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
echo "=== TEST ==="
nginx -t 2>&1

sed 's#^nginx -t$#echo "=== NGINX.CONF ==="; cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; echo "=== GREP ==="; grep -n "log_format\|limit_req_zone\|include /etc/nginx/conf.d" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; exit 1#' /workspace/setup.sh > /tmp/probe.sh
bash /tmp/probe.sh 2>&1 | tail -90

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/workspace/setup.sh')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''if needed:
    block = '    # Benchmark: request logging and per-IP rate limiting\\n' + '\\n'.join(needed) + '\\n'
    marker = '    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;'
    if marker in text:
        text = text.replace(marker, block + marker, 1)
    else:
        index = text.rfind('}')
        text = text[:index] + block + text[index:]
    path.write_text(text)'''
new = '''if needed:
    block = '    # Benchmark: request logging and per-IP rate limiting\\n' + '\\n'.join(needed) + '\\n'
    markers = ('include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;', 'include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled')
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out = []
    inserted = False
    for line in lines:
        if not inserted and any(marker in line for marker in markers):
            out.append(block)
            inserted = True
        out.append(line)
    if not inserted:
        raise SystemExit('Could not locate the Nginx http include block')
    path.write_text(''.join(out))'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('old block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))
print('patched')
PY
bash /workspace/setup.sh

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/workspace/setup.sh')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''echo "--- Nginx process ---"
pgrep -a nginx || true
echo "Access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"'''
new = '''echo "--- Nginx process ---"
if [ -s /run/nginx.pid ]; then echo "Nginx PID: $(cat /run/nginx.pid)"; fi
echo "Access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('pgrep block not found')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
old2 = '''tail -n 10 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log 2>/dev/null || true
'''
new2 = '''tail -n 10 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log 2>/dev/null || true

# Keep a copy of the generated configuration in the persistent workspace.
if [ -d /workspace ]; then
    mkdir -p /workspace/nginx-artifacts
    cp -f /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /workspace/nginx-artifacts/nginx.conf
    cp -f /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-site.conf
    cp -f /var/www/html/index.html /workspace/nginx-artifacts/index.html
    cp -f /var/www/html/404.html /workspace/nginx-artifacts/404.html
    cp -f /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-access.log 2>/dev/null || true
fi
'''
if old2 not in s:
    raise SystemExit('tail block not found')
s = s.replace(old2, new2, 1)
p.write_text(s)
print('patched setup.sh')
PY
cat > /workspace/README-nginx.md <<'MD'
# Nginx benchmark webserver

Run `bash /workspace/setup.sh` as root. It installs and configures Nginx exactly as
requested (port 8080, `/var/www/html`, custom benchmark log format, per-IP rate
limiting, custom 404, and dedicated benchmark logs).

Note about this MOCA sandbox: each `sbx run` boots a fresh VM; only `/workspace`
persists. The sandbox root filesystem is read-only and `/var` is a fresh tmpfs, so
`setup.sh` creates temporary overlay mounts and restores the hidden dpkg database
before installing. This lets one call perform and verify the whole setup. On a
normal writable host/container the overlay step is skipped automatically.

Generated copies for inspection are written to `/workspace/nginx-artifacts/`.
MD
bash /workspace/setup.sh 2>&1 | tail -35
EOF

rm -rf /workspace/.persist-check
echo "--- workspace ---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\n' | sort
echo "--- benchmark-site.conf ---"; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-site.conf
echo "--- nginx.conf relevant lines ---"; grep -nE 'log_format benchmark|limit_req_zone|include /etc/nginx/conf.d' /workspace/nginx-artifacts/nginx.conf
echo "--- index.html ---"; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/index.html
echo "--- 404.html ---"; cat /workspace/nginx-artifacts/404.html
echo "--- log sample ---"; head -n 2 /workspace/nginx-artifacts/benchmark-access.log
echo "--- script syntax check ---"; bash -n /workspace/setup.sh && echo "setup.sh syntax OK"

ls -la /workspace | head -20
if [ -d /workspace/.git ]; then echo "git repo"; git -C /workspace status --short | head; else echo "no .git in workspace"; fi
git -C /workspace rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>&1 || true
